description: Grafana error rate dashboard with three panels: HTTP 502 errors by endpoint, error rate percentage over time, and affected service breakdown. Shows error spike from 0.1% to 3.2% correlating with Gaudi health check failure.
visual_elements: Error rate percentage chart (spike from 0.1% to 3.2%)
HTTP 502 count by endpoint (bar chart, /v1/route highest)
demo_context: Companion to the latency spike dashboard — shows the error impact of the Gaudi memory pressure event.
